beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: The outfinite describes open continuation through steps that are actually finite.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: An available next step does not guarantee resources for every future step.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: A process may stop, branch, encounter a hard constraint, or change direction.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: The book distinguishes this image from claims about completed mathematical infinities.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: It does not dismiss Cantor’s mathematics or announce a replacement foundation as established.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: Instead, it questions practical promises that quietly borrow the prestige of limitlessness.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: Economic ambition, technical projects, and personal commitments all encounter realized constraints.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: The fuller discussion shows why both continuation and stopping deserve explicit justification.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: A simulated molecule and an observed molecule support different kinds of claims.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: The same word, exists, can conceal the difference when information moves between systems.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: The author separates theoretical objects, representations, computations, physical entities, and continuing processes.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: Collectives introduce another difficulty, because members can change while coordination continues.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: These categories earn their place only if they change which inferences are allowed.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: A label that leaves every conclusion untouched would merely decorate the argument.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: This chapter gives readers a precise way to identify a familiar category mistake.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: A representation cannot become physical evidence simply because its description sounds complete.
